method: Generated raster snow color-extracted and inverse-affine registered. Clip only to independently traced A/B common main-roof support to exclude timber gables and chimney stacks; no house pixels repainted. Coverage alpha-weighted against each independent roof mask.
visual: Broad winter blanket with irregular scalloped edge and scattered original orange tiles visible through alpha holes. L4 front-side snowbank reaches chimney-base junction, chimney stack and cap unobscured. L3b chimney unobscured. Canopies left unsnowed as main-roof task.
limitations: Manual roof support boundary +/-2 native pixels; A/B roof differences leave some roof-edge tile margins.
